'campaign_id' => $campaignId,\n            'readiness_score' => $this->readinessScore($signals),\n            'open_quests' => $openQuests,\n            'friendly_npcs' => $friendlyNpcs,\n            'scheduled_sessions' => $scheduledSessions,\n            'inventory_items' => $inventoryItems,\n        ];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Build a risk report from campaign signals and optional zero-count checks.\n     */\n    public function riskReport(string $campaignId, bool $includeZeroes): array\n    {\n        $signals = $this->signals($campaignId);\n        $signalKeys = ['has_dm', 'has_characters', 'has_next_session', 'has_active_quest'];\n        $missing = [];\n        foreach ($signalKeys as $key) {\n            if (!$signals[$key]) {\n                $missing[] = $key;\n            }\n        }\n        $missingSignalCount = count($missing);\n\n        $openQuests = $this->storage->getCampaignOpenQuestCount($campaignId);\n        $friendlyNpcs = $this->storage->getCampaignFriendlyNpcCount($campaignId);\n        $scheduledSessions = $this->storage->getCampaignSessionCount($campaignId);\n        $inventoryItems = $this->storage->getCampaignInventoryItemCount($campaignId);\n\n        if ($includeZeroes) {\n            if ($openQuests === 0) {\n                $missing[] = 'open_quests';\n            }\n            if ($friendlyNpcs === 0) {\n                $missing[] = 'friendly_npcs';\n            }\n            if ($scheduledSessions === 0) {\n                $missing[] = 'scheduled_sessions';\n            }\n            if ($inventoryItems === 0) {\n                $missing[] = 'inventory_items';\n            }\n        }\n\n        return [\n            'campaign_id' => $campaignId,\n            'risk_level' => $this->riskLevel($missingSignalCount),\n            'missing' => $missing,\n            'signals' => $signals,\n        ];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Compute the boolean readiness as \"2d6+3\".\n */\nfinal class Dice\n{\n    /**\n     * Parse a dice expression of the form XdY[+|-Z].\n     *\n     * Returns null when the expression does not match the supported grammar.\n     */\n    public static function parse(string $expression): ?array\n    {\n        if (!preg_match('/^(?P<count>0*[1-9]\\d*)d(?P<sides>0*[1-9]\\d*)(?P<modifier>[+-]\\d+)?$/', trim($expression), $matches)) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        return [\n            'count' => (int) $matches['count'],\n            'sides' => (int) $matches['sides'],\n            'modifier' => isset($matches['modifier']) ? (int) $matches['modifier'] : 0,\n        ];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Compute deterministic statistics for a parsed dice expression.\n     */\n    public static function stats(int $count, int $sides, int $modifier): array\n    {\n        return [\n            'dice_count' => $count,\n            'sides' => $sides,\n            'modifier' => $modifier,\n            'min' => $count + $modifier,\n            'max' => $count * $sides + $modifier,\n            'average' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($count * ($sides + 1) / 2 + $modifier),\n        ];\n    }\n}\n=== ./src/Domain/Encounter.php ===\n<?php\n\ndeclare(strict_types=1);\n\nnamespace App\\Domain;\n\nuse App\\Util\\Numbers;\n\n/**\n * Encounter difficulty calculation using the DMG encounter-building rules.\n *\n * The supported Challenge Ratings and party thresholds are intentionally small\n * and match the original implementation. Expanding the tables is a safe\n * additive change.\n */\nfinal class Encounter\n{\n    private const XP_BY_CR = [\n        '0' => 10,\n        '1/8' => 25,\n        '1/4' => 50,\n        '1/2' => 100,\n        '1' => 200,\n        '2' => 450,\n        '3' => 700,\n        '4' => 1100,\n        '5' => 1800,\n    ];\n\n    private const THRESHOLDS_BY_LEVEL = [\n        3 => ['easy' => 75, 'medium' => 150, 'hard' => 225, 'deadly' => 400],\n    ];\n\n    /**\n     * Calculate encounter metrics from a party and a list of monsters.\n     *\n     * The monster list must be pre-validated: each entry has 'cr' and 'count'.\n     * The party list must have entries with an integer 'level'.\n     *\n     * Returns an array with 'error' on validation failure, otherwise the\n     * encounter summary.\n     */\n    public static function calculate(array $party, array $monsters): array\n    {\n        $baseXp = 0;\n        $monsterCount = 0;\n        foreach ($monsters as $monster) {\n            $cr = (string) $monster['cr'];\n            if (!isset(self::XP_BY_CR[$cr])) {\n                return ['error' => 'unsupported cr'];\n            }\n\n            $count = (int) $monster['count'];\n            $monsterCount += $count;\n            $baseXp += self::XP_BY_CR[$cr] * $count;\n        }\n\n        if ($monsterCount <= 0) {\n            return ['error' => 'invalid monster count'];\n        }\n\n        $multiplier = match (true) {\n            $monsterCount === 1 => 1,\n            $monsterCount === 2 => 1.5,\n            $monsterCount <= 6 => 2,\n            $monsterCount <= 10 => 2.5,\n            $monsterCount <= 14 => 3,\n            default => 4,\n        };\n\n        $adjustedXp = $baseXp * $multiplier;\n\n        $sumThresholds = ['easy' => 0, 'medium' => 0, 'hard' => 0, 'deadly' => 0];\n        foreach ($party as $member) {\n            if (!is_array($member) || !isset($member['level']) || !is_int($member['level'])) {\n                return ['error' => 'invalid party member'];\n            }\n\n            $level = (int) $member['level'];\n            if (!isset(self::THRESHOLDS_BY_LEVEL[$level])) {\n                return ['error' => 'unsupported level'];\n            }\n\n            foreach (self::THRESHOLDS_BY_LEVEL[$level] as $key => $value) {\n                $sumThresholds[$key] += $value;\n            }\n        }\n\n        $difficulty = self::difficulty($adjustedXp, $sumThresholds);\n\n        return [\n            'base_xp' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($baseXp),\n            'monster_count' => $monsterCount,\n            'multiplier' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($multiplier),\n            'adjusted_xp' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($adjustedXp),\n            'difficulty' => $difficulty,\n            'thresholds' => [\n                'easy' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($sumThresholds['easy']),\n                'medium' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($sumThresholds['medium']),\n                'hard' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($sumThresholds['hard']),\n                'deadly' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($sumThresholds['deadly']),\n            ],\n        ];\n    }\n\n    public static function difficulty(float|int $adjustedXp, array $thresholds): string\n    {\n        $difficulty = 'trivial';\n        if ($adjustedXp >= $thresholds['easy']) {\n            $difficulty = 'easy';\n        }\n        if ($adjustedXp >= $thresholds['medium']) {\n            $difficulty = 'medium';\n        }\n        if ($adjustedXp >= $thresholds['hard']) {\n            $difficulty = 'hard';\n        }\n        if ($adjustedXp >= $thresholds['deadly']) {\n            $difficulty = 'deadly';\n        }\n\n        return $difficulty;\n    }\n\n    public static function xpByCr(): array\n    {\n        return self::XP_BY_CR;\n    }\n}\n=== ./src/Domain/RestRules.php App\\Domain;\n\nuse App\\Storage\\GameStorage;\n\n/**\n * Campaign readiness and risk analytics.\n *\n * These calculations were previously embedded in Controllers; moving them here\n * keeps the HTTP layer focused on request/response plumbing and makes the\n * scoring rules unit-testable without booting a web server.\n */\nfinal class CampaignAnalytics\n{\n    public function __construct(private GameStorage $storage)\n    {\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Summarise campaign readiness and supporting counts.\n     */\n    public function summary(string $campaignId): array\n    {\n        $signals = $this->signals($campaignId);\n        $openQuests = $this->storage->getCampaignOpenQuestCount($campaignId);\n        $friendlyNpcs = $this->storage->getCampaignFriendlyNpcCount($campaignId);\n        $scheduledSessions = $this->storage->getCampaignSessionCount($campaignId);\n        $inventoryItems = $this->storage->getCampaignInventoryItemCount($campaignId);\n\n        return [\n            'campaign_id' => $campaignId,\n            'readiness_score' => $this->readinessScore($signals),\n            'open_quests' => $openQuests,\n            'friendly_npcs' => $friendlyNpcs,\n            'scheduled_sessions' => $scheduledSessions,\n            'inventory_items' => $inventoryItems,\n        ];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Build a risk report from campaign signals and optional zero-count checks.\n     */\n    public function riskReport(string $campaignId, bool $includeZeroes): array\n    {\n        $signals = $this->signals($campaignId);\n        $signalKeys = ['has_dm', 'has_characters', 'has_next_session', 'has_active_quest'];\n        $missing = [];\n        foreach ($signalKeys as $key) {\n            if (!$signals[$key]) {\n                $missing[] = $key;\n            }\n        }\n        $missingSignalCount = count($missing);\n\n        $openQuests = $this->storage->getCampaignOpenQuestCount($campaignId);\n        $friendlyNpcs = $this->storage->getCampaignFriendlyNpcCount($campaignId);\n        $scheduledSessions = $this->storage->getCampaignSessionCount($campaignId);\n        $inventoryItems = $this->storage->getCampaignInventoryItemCount($campaignId);\n\n        if ($includeZeroes) {\n            if ($openQuests === 0) {\n                $missing[] = 'open_quests';\n            }\n            if ($friendlyNpcs === 0) {\n                $missing[] = 'friendly_npcs';\n            }\n            if ($scheduledSessions === 0) {\n                $missing[] = 'scheduled_sessions';\n            }\n            if ($inventoryItems === 0) {\n                $missing[] = 'inventory_items';\n            }\n        }\n\n        return [\n            'campaign_id' => $campaignId,\n            'risk_level' => $this->riskLevel($missingSignalCount),\n            'missing' => $missing,\n            'signals' => $signals,\n        ];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Compute the boolean readiness as \"2d6+3\".\n */\nfinal class Dice\n{\n    /**\n     * Parse a dice expression of the form XdY[+|-Z].\n     *\n     * Returns null when the expression does not match the supported grammar.\n     */\n    public static function parse(string $expression): ?array\n    {\n        if (!preg_match('/^(?P<count>0*[1-9]\\d*)d(?P<sides>0*[1-9]\\d*)(?P<modifier>[+-]\\d+)?$/', trim($expression), $matches)) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        return [\n            'count' => (int) $matches['count'],\n            'sides' => (int) $matches['sides'],\n            'modifier' => isset($matches['modifier']) ? (int) $matches['modifier'] : 0,\n        ];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Compute deterministic statistics for a parsed dice expression.\n     */\n    public static function stats(int $count, int $sides, int $modifier): array\n    {\n        return [\n            'dice_count' => $count,\n            'sides' => $sides,\n            'modifier' => $modifier,\n            'min' => $count + $modifier,\n            'max' => $count * $sides + $modifier,\n            'average' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($count * ($sides + 1) / 2 + $modifier),\n        ];\n    }\n}\n=== ./src/Domain/Encounter.php ===\n<?php\n\ndeclare(strict_types=1);\n\nnamespace App\\Domain;\n\nuse App\\Util\\Numbers;\n\n/**\n * Encounter difficulty calculation using the DMG encounter-building rules.\n *\n * The supported Challenge Ratings and party thresholds are intentionally small\n * and match the original implementation. Expanding the tables is a safe\n * additive change.\n */\nfinal class Encounter\n{\n    private const XP_BY_CR = [\n        '0' => 10,\n        '1/8' => 25,\n        '1/4' => 50,\n        '1/2' => 100,\n        '1' => 200,\n        '2' => 450,\n        '3' => 700,\n        '4' => 1100,\n        '5' => 1800,\n    ];\n\n    private const THRESHOLDS_BY_LEVEL = [\n        3 => ['easy' => 75, 'medium' => 150, 'hard' => 225, 'deadly' => 400],\n    ];\n\n    /**\n     * Calculate encounter metrics from a party and a list of monsters.\n     *\n     * The monster list must be pre-validated: each entry has 'cr' and 'count'.\n     * The party list must have entries with an integer 'level'.\n     *\n     * Returns an array with 'error' on validation failure, otherwise the\n     * encounter summary.\n     */\n    public static function calculate(array $party, array $monsters): array\n    {\n        $baseXp = 0;\n        $monsterCount = 0;\n        foreach ($monsters as $monster) {\n            $cr = (string) $monster['cr'];\n            if (!isset(self::XP_BY_CR[$cr])) {\n                return ['error' => 'unsupported cr'];\n            }\n\n            $count = (int) $monster['count'];\n            $monsterCount += $count;\n            $baseXp += self::XP_BY_CR[$cr] * $count;\n        }\n\n        if ($monsterCount <= 0) {\n            return ['error' => 'invalid monster count'];\n        }\n\n        $multiplier = match (true) {\n            $monsterCount === 1 => 1,\n            $monsterCount === 2 => 1.5,\n            $monsterCount <= 6 => 2,\n            $monsterCount <= 10 => 2.5,\n            $monsterCount <= 14 => 3,\n            default => 4,\n        };\n\n        $adjustedXp = $baseXp * $multiplier;\n\n        $sumThresholds = ['easy' => 0, 'medium' => 0, 'hard' => 0, 'deadly' => 0];\n        foreach ($party as $member) {\n            if (!is_array($member) || !isset($member['level']) || !is_int($member['level'])) {\n                return ['error' => 'invalid party member'];\n            }\n\n            $level = (int) $member['level'];\n            if (!isset(self::THRESHOLDS_BY_LEVEL[$level])) {\n                return ['error' => 'unsupported level'];\n            }\n\n            foreach (self::THRESHOLDS_BY_LEVEL[$level] as $key => $value) {\n                $sumThresholds[$key] += $value;\n            }\n        }\n\n        $difficulty = self::difficulty($adjustedXp, $sumThresholds);\n\n        return [\n            'base_xp' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($baseXp),\n            'monster_count' => $monsterCount,\n            'multiplier' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($multiplier),\n            'adjusted_xp' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($adjustedXp),\n            'difficulty' => $difficulty,\n            'thresholds' => [\n                'easy' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($sumThresholds['easy']),\n                'medium' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($sumThresholds['medium']),\n                'hard' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($sumThresholds['hard']),\n                'deadly' => Numbers::toIntegerWhenWhole($sumThresholds['deadly']),\n            ],\n        ];\n    }\n\n    public static function difficulty(float|int $adjustedXp, array $thresholds): string\n    {\n        $difficulty = 'trivial';\n        if ($adjustedXp >= $thresholds['easy']) {\n            $difficulty = 'easy';\n        }\n        if ($adjustedXp >= $thresholds['medium']) {\n            $difficulty = 'medium';\n        }\n        if ($adjustedXp >= $thresholds['hard']) {\n            $difficulty = 'hard';\n        }\n        if ($adjustedXp >= $thresholds['deadly']) {\n            $difficulty = AND target = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$id, $activeName]);\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n            $newRemaining = (int) $row['remaining_rounds'] - 1;\n            if ($newRemaining > 0) {\n                $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE combat_conditions SET remaining_rounds = ? WHERE id = ?');\n                $upd->execute([$newRemaining, $row['id']]);\n            } else {\n                $del = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM combat_conditions WHERE id = ?');\n                $del->execute([$row['id']]);\n            }\n        }\n\n        $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE combat_sessions SET round = ?, turn_index = ? WHERE id = ?');\n        $upd->execute([$newRound, $newIndex, $id]);\n\n        $session['round'] = $newRound;\n        $session['turn_index'] = $newIndex;\n        $session['conditions'] = $this->getConditionsMap($id);\n        foreach ($session['order'] as $combatant) {\n            $name = $combatant['name'];\n            if (!isset($session['conditions'][$name])) {\n                $session['conditions'][$name] = [];\n            }\n        }\n\n        return $session;\n    }\n\n    public function createMonster(array $data): bool\n    {\n        try {\n            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO compendium_monsters (slug, name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, tags_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n            $stmt->execute([\n                $data['slug'],\n                $data['name'],\n                $data['cr'],\n                $data['armor_class'],\n                $data['hit_points'],\n                json_encode($data['tags'] ?? AND target = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$id, $activeName]);\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n            $newRemaining = (int) $row['remaining_rounds'] - 1;\n            if ($newRemaining > 0) {\n                $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE combat_conditions SET remaining_rounds = ? WHERE id = ?');\n                $upd->execute([$newRemaining, $row['id']]);\n            } else {\n                $del = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM combat_conditions WHERE id = ?');\n                $del->execute([$row['id']]);\n            }\n        }\n\n        $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE combat_sessions SET round = ?, turn_index = ? WHERE id = ?');\n        $upd->execute([$newRound, $newIndex, $id]);\n\n        $session['round'] = $newRound;\n        $session['turn_index'] = $newIndex;\n        $session['conditions'] = $this->getConditionsMap($id);\n        foreach ($session['order'] as $combatant) {\n            $name = $combatant['name'];\n            if (!isset($session['conditions'][$name])) {\n                $session['conditions'][$name] = [];\n            }\n        }\n\n        return $session;\n    }\n\n    public function createMonster(array $data): bool\n    {\n        try {\n            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO compendium_monsters (slug, name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, tags_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n            $stmt->execute([\n                $data['slug'],\n                $data['name'],\n                $data['cr'],\n                $data['armor_class'],\n                $data['hit_points'],\n                json_encode($data['tags'] ?? AND id = ?');\n            $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n            $row = $stmt->fetch();\n            if (!$row) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $order = $this->resolveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $row['combatants_json']);\n            $count = count($order);\n            $turnIndex = (int) $row['turn_index'];\n            $round = (int) $row['round'];\n            $newTurnIndex = $turnIndex;\n            $newRound = $round;\n            if ($count > 0) {\n                $newTurnIndex = $turnIndex + 1;\n                if ($newTurnIndex >= $count) {\n                    $newTurnIndex = 0;\n                    $newRound++;\n                }\n                $activeId = $this->combatantIdentifier($order[$newTurnIndex] ?? null);\n                if ($activeId !== null) {\n                    $this->expirePlayCampaignEncounterConditions($campaignId, $encounterId, $activeId);\n                }\n            }\n\n            $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET round = ?, turn_index = ?       throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function damagePlayCampaignEncounterCombatant(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $target, int $amount): ?array\n    {\n        $monster = $characterId, string $outcome): ?array\n    {\n        $member = $this->getPlayCampaignMemberByCharacterId($campaignId, $characterId);\n        if ($member === null) {\n            return null;\n      $successes++;\n            if ($successes >= 3) {\n                $status = 'stable';\n            }\n        } elseif ($outcome === 'failure') {\n            $failures++;\n            if WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$hpCurrent, $status, $successes, $failures, $campaignId, $username]);\n\n        return $stmt->rowCount() > 0;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Resolve the current initiative order for an encounter.\n     *\n     * If a stored order exists it is used; otherwise the order is computed\n     * deterministically from monster and member initiatives and persisted.\n     * The returned entries include an internal 'member' key for ownership checks.\n     */\n    private function resolveEncounterOrder(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        $stored = null;\n        if ($row && !empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            $stored = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        }\n\n        if ($stored === null || count($stored) === 0) {\n            $entries = $this->computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $combatantsJson);\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n\n            return $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        }\n\n        $order = $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $stored, $combatantsJson);\n        if (count($order) === 0) {\n            $entries = $this->computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $combatantsJson);\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n\n            return $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        }\n\n        return $order;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Compute a sorted order entry list from current monsters and members.\n     */\n    private function computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT monster_id, name, initiative FROM play_campaign_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? ORDER BY name');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $entries = [];\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n            $entries[] = [\n                'kind' => 'monster',\n                'id' => $row['monster_id'],\n                'name' => $row['name'],\n                'initiative' => (int) $row['initiative'],\n            ];\n        }\n\n        $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        foreach ($members as $c) {\n            $entries[] = [\n                'kind' => 'member',\n                'id' => $c['member'] ?? '',\n                'name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''),\n                'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0),\n            ];\n        }\n\n        usort($entries, static function (array $a, array $b): int {\n            if ($a['initiative'] !== $b['initiative']) {\n                return $b['initiative'] <=> $a['initiative'];\n            }\n\n            return strcmp($a['name'], $b['name']);\n        });\n\n        return array_map(static fn (array $e): array => ['kind' => $e['kind'], 'id' => $e['id']], $entries);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Hydrate stored order entries into full combatant records.\n     */\n    private function hydrateEncounterOrderEntries(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $entries, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        $memberMap = [];\n        foreach ($members as $c) {\n            $memberMap[$c['member'] ?? ''] = $c;\n        }\n\n        $order = [];\n        foreach ($entries as $entry) {\n            $kind = $entry['kind'] ?? '';\n            $id = $entry['id'] ?? '';\n            if ($kind === 'monster') {\n                $m = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $id);\n                if ($m === null) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                $order[] = [\n                    'name' => $m['name'],\n                    'kind' => 'monster',\n                    'initiative' => $m['initiative'],\n                    'monster_id' => $m['monster_id'],\n                    'member' => null,\n                    'character_id' => null,\n                ];\n            } elseif ($kind === 'member' && isset($memberMap[$id])) {\n                $c = $memberMap[$id];\n                $order[] = [\n                    'name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''),\n                    'kind' => 'member',\n                    'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0),\n                    'member' => $c['member'] ?? null,\n                    'character_id' => $c['character_id'] ?? null,\n                    'monster_id' => null,\n                ];\n            }\n        }\n\n        return $order;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Persist the order entry list for an encounter.\n     */\n    private function saveEncounterOrder(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $entries): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET order_json = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([json_encode($entries, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR), $campaignId, $encounterId]);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Insert a new combatant into an existing stored order by initiative.\n     */\n    private function insertEncounterOrderEntry(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $newEntry): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json, combatants_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row || empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $combatantsJson = $row['combatants_json'];\n        $entries = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        if (count($entries) === 0) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $newFull = null;\n        if ($newEntry['kind'] === 'monster') {\n            $m = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $newEntry['id']);\n            if ($m !== null) {\n                $newFull = ['name' => $m['name'], 'initiative' => $m['initiative']];\n            }\n        } else {\n            $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n            foreach ($members as $c) {\n                if (($c['member'] ?? '') === $newEntry['id']) {\n                    $newFull = ['name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''), 'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0)];\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if ($newFull === null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $insertIndex = count($entries);\n        $full = $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        foreach ($full as $i => $entry) {\n            if ($newFull['initiative'] > $entry['initiative']\n                || ($newFull['initiative'] === $entry['initiative'] && strcmp($newFull['name'], $entry['name']) < 0)) {\n                $insertIndex = $i;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        array_splice($entries, $insertIndex, 0, [$newEntry]);\n        $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Remove a combatant from the stored order, if one exists.\n     */\n    private function removeEncounterOrderEntry(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $kind, string $id): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row || empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $entries = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        $filtered = [];\n        foreach ($entries as $entry) {\n            if (($entry['kind'] ?? AND id = ?\");\n            $upd->execute([json_encode($remaining, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR), $campaignId, $encounterId]);\n            $this->removeEncounterOrderEntry($campaignId, $encounterId, 'member', $member);\n            $this->pdo->exec('COMMIT');\n\n            return true;\n        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function getPlayCampaignEncounterTurn(string $campaignId, string $encounterId): ?array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT round, turn_index, combatants_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? $characterId, string $outcome): ?array\n    {\n        $member = $this->getPlayCampaignMemberByCharacterId($campaignId, $characterId);\n        if ($member === null) {\n            return null;\n WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$hpCurrent, $status, $successes, $failures, $campaignId, $username]);\n\n        return $stmt->rowCount() > 0;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Resolve the current initiative order for an encounter.\n     *\n     * If a stored order exists it is used; otherwise the order is computed\n     * deterministically from monster and member initiatives and persisted.\n     * The returned entries include an internal 'member' key for ownership checks.\n     */\n    private function resolveEncounterOrder(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        $stored = null;\n        if ($row && !empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            $stored = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        }\n\n        if ($stored === null || count($stored) === 0) {\n            $entries = $this->computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $combatantsJson);\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n\n            return $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        }\n\n        $order = $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $stored, $combatantsJson);\n        if (count($order) === 0) {\n            $entries = $this->computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $combatantsJson);\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n\n            return $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        }\n\n        return $order;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Compute a sorted order entry list from current monsters and members.\n     */\n    private function computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT monster_id, name, initiative FROM play_campaign_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? ORDER BY name');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $entries = [];\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n            $entries[] = [\n                'kind' => 'monster',\n                'id' => $row['monster_id'],\n                'name' => $row['name'],\n                'initiative' => (int) $row['initiative'],\n            ];\n        }\n\n        $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        foreach ($members as $c) {\n            $entries[] = [\n                'kind' => 'member',\n                'id' => $c['member'] ?? '',\n                'name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''),\n                'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0),\n            ];\n        }\n\n        usort($entries, static function (array $a, array $b): int {\n            if ($a['initiative'] !== $b['initiative']) {\n                return $b['initiative'] <=> $a['initiative'];\n            }\n\n            return strcmp($a['name'], $b['name']);\n        });\n\n        return array_map(static fn (array $e): array => ['kind' => $e['kind'], 'id' => $e['id']], $entries);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Hydrate stored order entries into full combatant records.\n     */\n    private function hydrateEncounterOrderEntries(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $entries, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        $memberMap = [];\n        foreach ($members as $c) {\n            $memberMap[$c['member'] ?? ''] = $c;\n        }\n\n        $order = [];\n        foreach ($entries as $entry) {\n            $kind = $entry['kind'] ?? '';\n            $id = $entry['id'] ?? '';\n            if ($kind === 'monster') {\n                $m = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $id);\n                if ($m === null) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                $order[] = [\n                    'name' => $m['name'],\n                    'kind' => 'monster',\n                    'initiative' => $m['initiative'],\n                    'monster_id' => $m['monster_id'],\n                    'member' => null,\n                    'character_id' => null,\n                ];\n            } elseif ($kind === 'member' && isset($memberMap[$id])) {\n                $c = $memberMap[$id];\n                $order[] = [\n                    'name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''),\n                    'kind' => 'member',\n                    'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0),\n                    'member' => $c['member'] ?? null,\n                    'character_id' => $c['character_id'] ?? null,\n                    'monster_id' => null,\n                ];\n            }\n        }\n\n        return $order;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Persist the order entry list for an encounter.\n     */\n    private function saveEncounterOrder(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $entries): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET order_json = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([json_encode($entries, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR), $campaignId, $encounterId]);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Insert a new combatant into an existing stored order by initiative.\n     */\n    private function insertEncounterOrderEntry(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $newEntry): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json, combatants_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row || empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $combatantsJson = $row['combatants_json'];\n        $entries = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        if (count($entries) === 0) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $newFull = null;\n        if ($newEntry['kind'] === 'monster') {\n            $m = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $newEntry['id']);\n            if ($m !== null) {\n                $newFull = ['name' => $m['name'], 'initiative' => $m['initiative']];\n            }\n        } else {\n            $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n            foreach ($members as $c) {\n                if (($c['member'] ?? '') === $newEntry['id']) {\n                    $newFull = ['name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''), 'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0)];\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if ($newFull === null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $insertIndex = count($entries);\n        $full = $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        foreach ($full as $i => $entry) {\n            if ($newFull['initiative'] > $entry['initiative']\n                || ($newFull['initiative'] === $entry['initiative'] && strcmp($newFull['name'], $entry['name']) < 0)) {\n                $insertIndex = $i;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        array_splice($entries, $insertIndex, 0, [$newEntry]);\n        $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Remove a combatant from the stored order, if one exists.\n     */\n    private function removeEncounterOrderEntry(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $kind, string $id): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row || empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $entries = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        $filtered = [];\n        foreach ($entries as $entry) {\n            if (($entry['kind'] ??
